relations: Repeated claw tool stabs on the can's side trigger wider foam sprays and droplets falling toward the grass.
Between stabs, continuous foamy liquid arcs from the can onto the plank and drips off its left edge.
The upright beer can remains stationary on the level wooden plank throughout the repeated stabbing interactions.
The orange-gloved hand pulls the multi-pronged claw tool back to the left after each stabbing contact.
caption: Against a white brick wall and green grass, a pale wooden plank lies level on a tree stump, holding an upright DAB beer can near its center. A white foamy liquid is already spurting from the can's left side. It arcs onto the plank and drips off the left edge toward the stump below. On the left, a person in blue jeans and an orange work glove grips an orange multi-pronged claw tool and repeatedly drives it toward the can's side, making stabbing contacts before pulling it back to the left. The contacts send foam bursting outward in wider sprays, while between them the liquid continues its arcing flow. Droplets scatter into the air near the can during the pokes and fall toward the grass. The can remains upright on the plank throughout, and the view stays largely fixed.
